title: Add McpTool and HttpSocketTransport invariant verifiers in susi-harness
goal: Add McpTool::verify_tool_invariants and HttpSocketTransport::verify_transport_invariants in crates/susi-harness/src/mcp.rs with comprehensive unit tests rejecting corrupt state.
acceptance: McpTool::verify_tool_invariants validates non-empty tool name and JSON object schema; HttpSocketTransport::verify_transport_invariants validates non-empty host, non-zero port, slash-prefixed path, non-zero timeout, and supported protocol version.
